title: Drinking Water Filter Maintenance Alarm
problem: Hostel RO water purifiers break down often because the filter candles get clogged with mud, and nobody remembers the last replacement date.
idea: A filter counter. It counts the days since the last cleaning and rings an alarm when cleaning or changing is due. Enter your dates to see.

widgets.heading: 🧮 Is filter cleaning due?
widgets.intro: Check the purifier book for how often the filter should be cleaned. Many candle filters need cleaning every few weeks, and more often if the water is muddy.

inputs.label: Clean every ___ days (from the purifier book)

widgets.formula: if (typeof since !== 'number' || typeof every !== 'number' || typeof water !== 'number') return null; if (since < 0 || every <= 0) return null; var limit = Math.round(every * water); var left = limit - since; var msg, level; if (left < 0) { msg = '🔔 ALARM! Cleaning is ' + (-left) + ' days late. Tell the warden today.'; level = 'bad'; } else if (left <= 5) { msg = '🟡 Cleaning due in ' + left + ' days. Get ready.'; level = 'warn'; } else { msg = '🟢 OK. Next cleaning in ' + left + ' days.'; level = 'good'; } return {limit: limit, msg: msg, level: level};
widgets.result:
Cleaning needed every {limit} days for this water.
{msg}

items.text: Nobody knows the last cleaning date
items.te: చివరిసారి ఎప్పుడు శుభ్రం చేశారో ఎవరికీ తెలియదు

bands.text: Call the warden and the service person. Use boiled water meanwhile.
Watch closely and check the cleaning date.
Filter looks fine. Keep the date register updated.

items.title: Write the date
items.text: Stick a date card on the purifier every time it is cleaned.
items.te: శుభ్రం చేసిన ప్రతిసారీ తేదీ కార్డు అతికించండి.

items.title: Adults only
items.text: Only the trained staff or service person opens the machine.

items.title: Backup plan
items.text: If the purifier is broken, boil water for at least 1 minute and cool it.
items.te: ఫిల్టర్ పాడైతే నీళ్ళను కనీసం 1 నిమిషం మరిగించి చల్లార్చండి.

how: Read the purifier book (or ask the service person) to find how often the filter should be cleaned or changed.
In Scratch, use the 'days since 2000' block to count days since the last cleaning date.
Make a variable 'days left' = cleaning gap minus days passed.
If days left is 0 or less, play an alarm sound and show 'Clean the filter!' in red.
Keep a paper date card on the machine too, in case the computer is off.
Ask Gemini for safe drinking water tips to add to the screen.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain in simple English and Telugu why water purifier filters must be cleaned on time, the signs of a clogged filter, and what to do for safe drinking water if the purifier stops working.
